name: InnoDB状态变量监控诊断
description: InnoDB 状态变量是 MySQL 性能监控的基础数据源。关键指标分三组：Buffer Pool 组（Innodb_buffer_pool_reads/read_requests/pages_free/pages_dirty）、行操作组（Innodb_rows_read/inserted/updated/deleted）、日志组（Innodb_os_log_written/fsyncs/pending_fsyncs）。通过这些变量可以快速判断 InnoDB 的整体健康状态、内存效率和 IO 模式。

signals.desc: InnoDB 某项状态变量偏离正常基线
需要建立 InnoDB 监控基线

conditions.desc: 需要配置 InnoDB 监控

skip_when.desc: 已有完善的 InnoDB 监控体系

root_causes.name: Buffer Pool 压力指标异常
root_causes.desc: Innodb_buffer_pool_reads（物理读）速率高、pages_free 为 0、wait_free > 0 都表示 buffer pool 吃紧。read_requests 是逻辑读，reads 是物理读，比率就是命中率。

root_causes.name: 行操作速率异常
root_causes.desc: Innodb_rows_read 远大于 rows_inserted/updated/deleted 说明读密集（可能有大量扫描）。rows_deleted 持续很高说明有批量删除操作。rows_inserted 突增可能是大批量导入。

root_causes.name: 日志写入瓶颈
root_causes.desc: Innodb_os_log_written 速率反映 redo log 写入量。Innodb_log_waits > 0 表示 redo log buffer 不够用，线程需要等待。Innodb_os_log_pending_fsyncs > 0 表示 fsync 操作堆积。

root_causes.name: 数据修改和 purge 不平衡
root_causes.desc: Innodb_rows_deleted 持续高但 purge 跟不上会导致 undo 膨胀。通过 Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_dirty 和 Innodb_data_pending_writes 判断脏页刷写压力。

step1_buffer_pool_status.desc: Buffer Pool 相关状态变量
step1_buffer_pool_status.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_buffer_pool_reads', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_total', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_free', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_dirty', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_flushed', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_wait_free', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_made_young', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_made_not_young', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_old') ORDER BY VARIABLE_NAME

step2_row_operations.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_rows_read', 'Innodb_rows_inserted', 'Innodb_rows_updated', 'Innodb_rows_deleted') ORDER BY VARIABLE_NAME

step3_log_status.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_os_log_written', 'Innodb_os_log_fsyncs', 'Innodb_os_log_pending_fsyncs', 'Innodb_os_log_pending_writes', 'Innodb_log_waits', 'Innodb_log_writes', 'Innodb_log_write_requests') ORDER BY VARIABLE_NAME

step4_data_io.desc: 数据 IO 状态变量
step4_data_io.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_data_reads', 'Innodb_data_writes', 'Innodb_data_fsyncs', 'Innodb_data_pending_reads', 'Innodb_data_pending_writes', 'Innodb_data_pending_fsyncs', 'Innodb_data_read', 'Innodb_data_written', 'Innodb_dblwr_writes', 'Innodb_dblwr_pages_written') ORDER BY VARIABLE_NAME

step5_lock_status.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_row_lock_current_waits', 'Innodb_row_lock_time', 'Innodb_row_lock_time_avg', 'Innodb_row_lock_time_max', 'Innodb_row_lock_waits', 'Innodb_deadlocks') ORDER BY VARIABLE_NAME

step6_comprehensive_snapshot.desc: 一次性获取所有 InnoDB 状态变量快照
step6_comprehensive_snapshot.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME LIKE 'Innodb_%' ORDER BY VARIABLE_NAME

real_world_examples.scenario: 通过 Innodb_log_waits 发现 redo log buffer 瓶颈
real_world_examples.symptoms: 高写入负载下 TPS 周期性下降，每隔几秒抖动一次
real_world_examples.root_cause: innodb_log_buffer_size=16MB，高并发写入时 redo log buffer 频繁满触发 flush
real_world_examples.result: Innodb_log_waits 不再增长，TPS 抖动消失
